title: The bounded below exchange comparison equation
statement:
Let (g':X'→X, f':X'→Y', f:X→Y, g:Y'→Y) be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. All sheaves are abelian sheaves on the small étale sites. Write F=f_*, F'=f'_*, G=g^{-1}, G'=g'^{-1} for the additive sheaf functors [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Write q_T for the quotient of ℤ-indexed cochain complexes on T to their homotopy category and Qh for its derived localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let ι_T:D⁺(T_et)→D(T_et) be the inclusion, R⁺F and R⁺F' the bounded below right derived functors, and let φ^G_M:G(Qh M)≅Qh(G M) and φ^{G'}_M denote the exact inverse-image comparison isomorphisms [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image].

Fix K∈D⁺(X_et) and put K'=G'K. Let E:K⁺(Inj(X_et))≌D⁺(X_et) and E':K⁺(Inj(X'_et))≌D⁺(X'_et) be the standard injective-object equivalences. Put P=ι_Inj(E^{-1}K), P'=ι_Inj(E'^{-1}K'), regarded as bounded below homotopy objects, and ρ=ι_X(E.counit_K^{-1}):ι_XK→Qh P, ρ'=ι_X'(E'.counit_K'^{-1}):ι_X'K'→Qh P'.

Let I be a K-injective cochain complex on X_et [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions], s:ι_XK≅Qh(q_X I) an isomorphism, J a K-injective cochain complex on X'_et, and j:G'I→J a quasi-isomorphism. Define t=G'(s.hom)≫(φ^{G'}_{q_X I}).hom≫Qh(q_X'(j)). Define ex₀:I under (F⋙G)→I under (G'⋙F') by applying the underived exchange [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange] term by term, and set e=ex₀≫F'(j). For arbitrary homotopy classes h₁:q_X I→P and h₂:q_X' J→P' satisfying s.hom≫Qh(h₁)=ρ and t≫Qh(h₂)=ρ', define
χ=Qh(F(h₁))≫ι_Y(Unit_{R⁺F,P}≫R⁺F(E.counit_K)),
χ'=Qh(F'(h₂))≫ι_Y'(Unit_{R⁺F',P'}≫R⁺F'(E'.counit_K')),
σsrc=(φ^G_{F(q_X I)})^{-1}≫G(χ).
Let Ex_K be the bounded below derived exchange [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]. The comparison equation referred to below is
σsrc≫ι_Y'(Ex_K)=Qh(q_Y'(e))≫χ'.

Assume additionally that there exists a specified integer n with I strictly concentrated in degrees ≥n. Then the comparison equation holds for every compatible pair (h₁,h₂). This asserts the equation only for bounded below I; neither J nor its complex representative is required to be bounded below. Existence, uniqueness and invertibility of the comparison classes are not part of this assertion.

proof.text: (The counit $\varepsilon^D_f$ on a K-injective resolution.) Claim: $\varepsilon^D_{f,K}\circ f^{-1}(\chi_{(I,s)})=s^{-1}\circ Q(\varepsilon_{f,I})\circ\varphi^f_{f_*I}$, where $\varepsilon_{f,I}=(\varepsilon_{f,I^r})_r$ and $\varepsilon^D_f$ is the counit of $f^{-1}\dashv Rf_*$ [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction]. Put $P=I(K)$, bounded below and K-injective. Property (1) of [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction] says, with the identification of $Q(f_*P)$ with $Rf_*(QP)$ used there, which is $\chi_{(P,\mathrm{id})}$ of step 1: $\varepsilon^D_{f,QP}\circ f^{-1}(\chi_{(P,\mathrm{id})})=Q(\varepsilon_{f,P})\circ\varphi^f_{f_*P}$. Naturality of $\varepsilon^D_f$ along $\rho_K:K\to QP$ gives $\rho_K\varepsilon^D_{f,K}=\varepsilon^D_{f,QP}\circ f^{-1}Rf_*(\rho_K)$, and $(\ast)$ for $a=\rho_K$, $(P,\rho_K)$, $(P,\mathrm{id})$, $\tilde a=\mathrm{id}$ gives $Rf_*(\rho_K)=Rf_*(\rho_K)\chi_{(P,\rho_K)}=\chi_{(P,\mathrm{id})}$. Hence $\varepsilon^D_{f,K}=\rho_K^{-1}Q(\varepsilon_{f,P})\varphi^f_{f_*P}$. For general $(I,s)$ let $h:I\to P$ be as in step 1 ($Q(h)s=\rho_K$, $\chi_{(I,s)}=Q(f_*h)$). By naturality of $\varphi^f$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image] and of the termwise counit [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy] (a), $\varphi^f_{f_*P}\circ f^{-1}Q(f_*h)=Q(f^{-1}f_*h)\varphi^f_{f_*I}$ and $\varepsilon_{f,P}\circ f^{-1}f_*h=h\circ\varepsilon_{f,I}$; so $\varepsilon^D_{f,K}f^{-1}(\chi_{(I,s)})=\rho_K^{-1}Q(h)Q(\varepsilon_{f,I})\varphi^f_{f_*I}=s^{-1}Q(\varepsilon_{f,I})\varphi^f_{f_*I}$.

(The unit $\eta^D_{f'}$ on a bounded below complex.) Let $N$ be a bounded below complex on $Y'_{\Et}$. A K-injective resolution $r:f'^{-1}N\to J_1$ exists: with $L=f'^{-1}(QN)$ and its chosen resolution $\rho_L$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], $\rho_L(\varphi^{f'}_N)^{-1}=Q(r)$ for a unique class $r:f'^{-1}N\to I(L)$ [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived], and $r$ is a quasi-isomorphism because $Q(r)$ is an isomorphism (the cohomology functors factor through $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]). For any such $r$, put $t_1=Q(r)\varphi^{f'}_N:f'^{-1}(QN)\xrightarrow{\sim}QJ_1$. Property (2) of [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction], with its identification $Rf'_*f'^{-1}(QN)\cong Q(f'_*J_1)$, which is $\chi_{(J_1,t_1)}$ of step 1 (for $J_1=I(L)$, $t_1=\rho_L$ it is the identity; for another $J_1$ the comparison $c$ with $cr=r'$ there is the inverse of the class $h$ of step 1), reads
$$
 \eta^D_{f',QN}=\chi_{(J_1,t_1)}\circ Q\bigl(f'_*(r)\circ\eta_{f',N}\bigr),\qquad \eta_{f',N}=(\eta_{f',N^r})_r .
$$

(The derived square isomorphism on complexes.) By [def-weil-pbc-derived-square-iso], $\theta^D_\square$ is the restriction to $\Dplus$ of a natural isomorphism $\theta^D_{\square,\mathrm{unb}}$ on $D$, and for every complex $M$ on $Y_{\Et}$
$$
 \theta^D_{\square,\mathrm{unb},QM}=\beta_2^{-1}\circ Q(\theta_{\square,M})\circ\beta_1,\quad \beta_1=\varphi^{f'}_{g^{-1}M}\circ f'^{-1}(\varphi^g_M),\ \beta_2=\varphi^{g'}_{f^{-1}M}\circ g'^{-1}(\varphi^f_M),
$$
with $\theta_{\square,M}=(\theta_{\square,M^r})_r$ (the isomorphisms $\beta_u$ of that node are the comparison isomorphisms $\varphi^u$ of [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], both being those of [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]).

proof.text: (Part (a): the termwise exchange is a morphism of complexes.) By [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange], $\Ex^0_{\square,F}$ is the transpose under $f'^{-1}\dashv f'_*$ of $c_F:=g'^{-1}(\varepsilon_{f,F})\circ\theta_{\square,f_*F}$, i.e. $\Ex^0_{\square,F}=f'_*(c_F)\circ\eta_{f',g^{-1}f_*F}$ (the hom bijection of the adjunction [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]). For the complex $I$ put $N=g^{-1}f_*I$ and $c=(c_{I^r})_r:f'^{-1}N\to g'^{-1}I$; $c$ commutes with the differentials because $\theta_\square$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] and $\varepsilon_f$ are natural and $g'^{-1}$ is a functor, and $\eta_{f',N}$ is a morphism of complexes [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy] (a). So $\Ex^0_{\square,I}=f'_*(c)\circ\eta_{f',N}$ is a morphism of complexes, and so is $e=f'_*(j)\circ f'_*(c)\circ\eta_{f',N}=f'_*(jc)\circ\eta_{f',N}$.

proof.text:
(Part (b) when $I$ is bounded below.) Assume $I$ bounded below; then $M:=f_*I$ and $N=g^{-1}M$ are bounded below ([lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy] (c)). Let $x=\chi_{(I,s)}:QM\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_*K$, so $\sigma_{\rm src}=g^{-1}(x)(\varphi^g_M)^{-1}$. By [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] (explicit form), $\Ex_{\square,K}=Rf'_*(b_K)\circ\eta^D_{f',g^{-1}Rf_*K}$ with $b_K=g'^{-1}(\varepsilon^D_{f,K})\circ\theta^D_{\square,Rf_*K}$. (i) Naturality of $\eta^D_{f'}$ along $\sigma_{\rm src}:QN\to g^{-1}Rf_*K$: $\Ex_{\square,K}\sigma_{\rm src}=Rf'_*\bigl(b_Kf'^{-1}(\sigma_{\rm src})\bigr)\circ\eta^D_{f',QN}$. (ii) By naturality of $\theta^D_{\square,\mathrm{unb}}$ along $x$, step 4, step 2 and naturality of $\varphi^{g'}$ along $\varepsilon_{f,I}$:
$$
 b_Kf'^{-1}(\sigma_{\rm src})=g'^{-1}\bigl(\varepsilon^D_{f,K}f^{-1}(x)\bigr)\circ\beta_2^{-1}Q(\theta_{\square,M})\varphi^{f'}_N
 =g'^{-1}(s)^{-1}(\varphi^{g'}_I)^{-1}\,Q(g'^{-1}\varepsilon_{f,I})\,Q(\theta_{\square,M})\,\varphi^{f'}_N=w\circ Q(c)\circ\varphi^{f'}_N,
$$
$w:=g'^{-1}(s)^{-1}(\varphi^{g'}_I)^{-1}$, $c$ as in step 5. (iii) Step 3 with $r:f'^{-1}N\to J_1$: $\eta^D_{f',QN}=\chi_{(J_1,t_1)}Q(f'_*(r)\eta_{f',N})$. (iv) Apply $(\ast)$ (for $u=f'$) to $a:=wQ(c)\varphi^{f'}_N:f'^{-1}(QN)\to g'^{-1}K$, $(J_1,t_1)$ and $(J,t)$, noting $t=Q(j)w^{-1}$: the class $\tilde a:J_1\to J$ is determined by $Q(\tilde a)Q(r)\varphi^{f'}_N=Q(j)Q(c)\varphi^{f'}_N$, i.e. $Q(\tilde ar)=Q(jc)$, so $\tilde ar\simeq jc$ [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]; and $Rf'_*(a)\chi_{(J_1,t_1)}=\chi_{(J,t)}Q(f'_*\tilde a)$. (v) Combining, and using that $f'_*$ preserves homotopies and step 5:
$$
 \Ex_{\square,K}\sigma_{\rm src}=\chi_{(J,t)}Q\bigl(f'_*(\tilde ar)\eta_{f',N}\bigr)=\chi_{(J,t)}Q\bigl(f'_*(jc)\eta_{f',N}\bigr)=\sigma_{\rm tgt}\circ Q(e).
$$

lean.statement:
lemma derivedExchangeBoundedComparison
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (s : DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj K ≅
      DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj I))
    (J : CochainComplex (Sheaf X'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    [J.IsKInjective]
    (j : (((g')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶ J)
    [QuasiIso j]
    (n : ℤ) [I.IsStrictlyGE n] :
    let B := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let C := Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B
    let C' := Sheaf X'.smallEtaleTopology B
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ)
    let q' := HomotopyCategory.quotient C' (.up ℤ)
    let qY := HomotopyCategory.quotient (Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology B) (.up ℤ)
    let F := (f)_*[B]
    let F' := (f')_*[B]
    let G := (g)^*[B]
    let G' := (g')^*[B]
    let E := DerivedCategory.Plus.injectiveObjectEquivalence C
    let E' := DerivedCategory.Plus.injectiveObjectEquivalence C'
    let K' := G'.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K
    let P := (InjectiveObject.ι C).mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj (E.inverse.obj K)
    let P' := (InjectiveObject.ι C').mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj (E'.inverse.obj K')
    let ρ := DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (E.counitIso.inv.app K)
    let ρ' := DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (E'.counitIso.inv.app K')
    let t := G'.mapDerivedCategory.map s.hom ≫
      G'.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app (q.obj I) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map (q'.map j)
    let ex₀ := (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex
      (Etale.baseChangeMap B sq.toCommSq) (.up ℤ)).app I
    let e := ex₀ ≫ (F'.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map j
    ∀ h : ((q.obj I ⟶ P.obj) × (q'.obj J ⟶ P'.obj)),
      s.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map h.1 = ρ →
      t ≫ DerivedCategory.Qh.map h.2 = ρ' →
      let χ := DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map h.1) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (F.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app P ≫
          F.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map (E.counitIso.hom.app K))
      let χ' := DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((F'.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).map h.2) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map (F'.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app P' ≫
          F'.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map (E'.counitIso.hom.app K'))
      let σsrc := G.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app
        ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj (q.obj I)) ≫ G.mapDerivedCategory.map χ
      σsrc ≫ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.map
          ((Etale.derivedBaseChangeMapPlus B sq.toCommSq).app K) =
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map (qY.map e) ≫ χ'
